name: Andaz Mayakoba Resort Riviera Maya
insider_take: Where contemporary luxury meets ancient Mayan mystique in a pristine coastal sanctuary that feels worlds away from ordinary resort experiences.
whats_special: This stunning property sits within the exclusive Mayakoba development, sharing its pristine coastline with only a handful of ultra-luxury resorts. The hotel's design seamlessly blends into the natural cenote-dotted landscape, featuring overwater suites connected by elevated walkways through mangrove forests. Andaz Mayakoba is the only adults-only resort in the Mayakoba complex, creating an intimate atmosphere perfect for sophisticated travelers.
pro_tip: Book a lagoon suite for direct access to kayaking through the property's private cenotes and mangrove channels – it's like having your own private water park with crystalline swimming holes right outside your door.
dont_miss: The resort's signature cenote experiences, including private dinners in underground caverns and sunrise yoga sessions on floating platforms. Take advantage of the complimentary bikes to explore the Greg Norman-designed El Camaleon golf course, and don't skip the temazcal ceremony – an authentic Mayan purification ritual conducted in a traditional sweat lodge by local shamans.
pros: Adults-only luxury resort with sophisticated ambiance
Prime beachfront location in exclusive Mayakoba development
Contemporary Mexican design with cenote-inspired pools
Access to championship golf course and marina
cons: Adults-only policy excludes families with children
